origin.origins_backgrounds.acolyte.name: Acolyte
origin.origins_backgrounds.acolyte.descr: Awọn Acolytes ti ni ikẹkọ lati ọdọ Awọn Clerics ati ni igbagbọ nla.
origin.origins_backgrounds.athlete.name: Elere
origin.origins_backgrounds.athlete.descr: Awọn elere idaraya ti kọ awọn ara wọn si pipe.
origin.origins_backgrounds.farmhand.name: Ọwọ oko
origin.origins_backgrounds.farmhand.desc: Won lo akoko sise lori oko elomiran.
origin.origins_backgrounds.fisher.name: Àwọn apẹja
origin.origins_backgrounds.fisher.descri: Awọn apẹja ti kọ ẹkọ ti ipeja.
origin.origins_backgrounds.guard.name: Oluso
origin.origins_backgrounds.guard.descrip: Idabobo awọn elomiran ati awọn ohun iyebiye wọn ti kọ wọn lati daabobo ara wọn pẹlu.
origin.origins_backgrounds.haunted.name: Ebora
origin.origins_backgrounds.haunted.descr: Ko si alejò si okunkun ati ajalu, Ebora gbe ipalara wọn ni idakẹjẹ. Nigbagbogbo.
origin.origins_backgrounds.retainer.name: Idaduro
origin.origins_backgrounds.retainer.desc: Tẹsiwaju aṣa atọwọdọwọ idile ti sìn Oluwa tabi Knight.
origin.origins_backgrounds.novice_mage.d: Awọn alakọbẹrẹ bẹrẹ ikẹkọ labẹ ikẹkọ Oluṣeto kan.
origin.origins_backgrounds.sailor.name: Atukọ
origin.origins_backgrounds.sailor.descri: Àwọn atukọ̀ náà máa ń lo àkókò tó pọ̀ jù láti swabbing dekini náà.
origin.origins_backgrounds.pirate.name: Ajalelokun
origin.origins_backgrounds.pirate.descri: Ifẹ wọn nikan ni okun. Ati emeralds. Ọpọlọpọ awọn emeralds.
origin.origins_backgrounds.cultist.name: Onisofin
origin.origins_backgrounds.cultist.descr: Àwọn oníṣọ́ọ̀ṣì ń sin àwọn ọlọ́run wọn lọ́nà àràmàǹdà.
origin.origins_backgrounds.scribe.name: Akọwe
origin.origins_backgrounds.scribe.descri: Awọn irora ọwọ lọ kuro nikẹhin.
origin.origins_backgrounds.soldier.name: Ọmọ ogun
origin.origins_backgrounds.soldier.descr: Ipo ati faili ti Ogun Oluwa.
origin.origins_backgrounds.fresh_face.de: Wọn ko ṣe ohunkohun ti akọsilẹ. Sibẹsibẹ.
origin.origins_backgrounds.coalminer.des: Gbogbo awọn irin ti ipamo ni lati wa ni erupẹ, kii ṣe eedu nikan.
origin.origins_backgrounds.cryptkeeper.d: Iṣẹ́ àṣekára ni títọ́jú ibojì òkú nígbà tí wọn kò bá dúró sí.
power.origins_backgrounds.improved_heali: Iwosan ni ipa 10% ti o ga julọ fun ọ.
power.origins_backgrounds.faster_speed.d: Ilọpo ilẹ rẹ ti pọ si nipasẹ 10%.
O jèrè Ounjẹ diẹ sii lati jijẹ ẹja ti o jinna. (Ko ṣe afihan pẹlu AppleSkin)
power.origins_backgrounds.shield_prowess: Lakoko lilo apata, o jèrè Resistance I.
power.origins_backgrounds.hello_darkness: O jẹ ajesara si ipa okunkun.
power.origins_backgrounds.trusty_hoe.des: O ni ohun enchanted Iron Hoe ti a ti kọja si isalẹ nipasẹ iran.
power.origins_backgrounds.attack_in_ocea: Nigbati o ba wa lori okun, awọn ikọlu rẹ jẹ igba meji ni iyara.
power.origins_backgrounds.eyepatch.name: Oju oju
power.origins_backgrounds.eyepatch.descr: Wọ oju oju lori awọn okun ṣiṣi gba ọ laaye lati tọju Iran Alẹ rẹ.
power.origins_backgrounds.graves.name: Pada si awọn Crypts rẹ
power.origins_backgrounds.graves.descrip: Imọ rẹ ti awọn okú gba ọ laaye lati fa ibajẹ 7.5% diẹ sii si Undead.
power.origins_backgrounds.legacy_sword.d: O ru idà ebi re. Ti baba rẹ ni, ati ti iya rẹ ati...
power.origins_backgrounds.paperbacks.des: Lẹhin kikọ awọn iwe pupọ pupọ, o nilo iwe mẹta nikan lati di ọkan.
power.origins_backgrounds.sacrifice.name: Ẹyẹ Ẹbọ
power.origins_backgrounds.sacrifice.desc: Ẹbọ adie si oluwa rẹ yoo fun ọ ni Iriri meji.
Iṣe rẹ pẹlu idà gba ọ laaye lati ṣe 5% afikun ibajẹ lakoko ti o nlo ọkan.
power.origins_backgrounds.potion_food.de: O ti jẹ ọpọlọpọ awọn oogun ti wọn jẹ ounjẹ ati Iwosan ni bayi.
